It requires navigating complex healthcare, education, and benefit systems, advocating constantly against social isolation, and managing heavy emotional and physical demands. It is a unique journey of deep advocacy, adaptation, and redefining expectations. Under the Abortion Act 1967, while there is a general 24-week limit for standard abortions, pregnancies can be terminated up to birth if two doctors agree there is a substantial risk that the child would be born "seriously handicapped".
